storage.reason.no_admitted_battery_profi.description: the registry did not select the battery profile for this family, so the documented battery mapping is not applied and every battery value is Unknown, never zero

storage.reason.battery_group_not_read.description: no battery offset is in any read plan and the group was not read; the value is Unknown and never zero

storage.reason.zero_word_is_not_a_batter.description: a zero word in a battery group, in a battery power field or in the rated storage capacity word is never a value of zero, and battery presence is never decided from it; a state of charge word of zero and a lifetime counter word of zero are values

storage.reason.battery_group_exception_n.description: an exception on a battery read does not negate the identified parent inverter and publishes no battery value

storage.reason.period_counter_time_domai.description: the pack's energy counters are lifetime counters and the period boundary and time domain of a day counter are Unknown, so a day counter is served in the modbusreg namespace and is never published as a lifetime fact

storage.reason.group_native_only_no_cata.description: the group answered and its words are served natively in the modbusreg namespace; no catalog row gives them a storage element yet

storage.reason.status_symbols_not_stated.description: the running-state word of the storage unit is read natively; its states carry no symbol table, so no operating state is published

storage.reason.sign_not_graded.description: the monitoring contract's site power row states no sign for the battery power at offset 30360, so no value is published with an assumed sign

storage.reason.value_outside_pack_range.description: the converted value lies outside the bounds of the pack element, so it is withheld and never clamped

storage.reason.aggregate_without_pack_ev.description: the reading is a site or plant group value and the configured battery has more than one pack, so no pack holds evidence for it; it is withheld and never assigned by list position

scenarios.note: a selected profile with no battery offset in the read plan: every item is withheld as not read, nothing is zero
